# 生命竊取附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ly-life-steal-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-life-steal-enchantment)
[![授權條款](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

`生命竊取` 武器附魔，共有3個等級，每提升一級，所需竊取的生命傷害值就會減少。

此附魔可經由附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得。

## ⌨️ 指令

給予：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot life_steal_enchantment:<等級>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s life_steal_enchantment:life_steal <等級>
```
